title: fleet-guards: CYCLE_MIN magnitude unchecked - 64-bit wraparound -> hot loop or silent hang
description: Codereview of a7p2 fix (security + edge passes, kimi-k3, convergent). Line 11 pattern ''|*[!0-9]*|0* constrains form but not magnitude; line 142 sleep $((CYCLE_MIN * 60)) is signed 64-bit with wraparound. Verified: 307445734561825861 wraps negative -> sleep fails instantly -> busy loop hammering bd + metered OpenRouter credits API; 99999999999999999999 wraps huge-positive -> guards silently hang (~152B year sleep), no alarms ever fire. Both are the silent-death class the guards exist to catch. Mitigating: only production caller is fleet-watchdog.sh with hardcoded 10; needs manual absurd input. Fix: add a range check after line 11, e.g. reject values > 1440.
